name: zero-salary
note: salary=0 — defensive case for prCalc's own arithmetic (the real divide-by-zero hazards named in the design, 1/2/3/4, all belong to calcLiq, not prCalc; this fixture only confirms prCalc itself does not panic/NaN at salary=0: b=0, every derived field is 0, and annual=(0/1)*13=0 so isrAnnual=0 (0<=11000), never a division).
